title: Signature line no return
creator: dmkroslindale
content:
In the recent version (24.0) the signature line option is no longer respecting a carriage return at the end of a line. When entering more than one line for a signature, you cannot enter a return and start a second line.

While the editor accepts this the preview pane and the final result does not respect the return and the lines wrap together. This did not happen with earlier versions. Signatures created with earlier versions continue to operate okay. Only the effort to add a new signature line or edit an existing one is being impacted.

It appears the CR is not being entered or read.
